items.title: Frank Amacker Interview, 1960-09-30
items.q: Charlie Parker had the place after Billy Phillips lost it.

ctx.x: Yeah, he's right. That's right. Charlie Parker was his brother. No, Charlie Parker had the place after Billy Phillips lost it. Charlie Parker and Harry Parker. Take it over after Billy Phillips got killed. And then the same man went across the street and killed Charlie Parker that same night. That same night, killed Harry Parker. That same night after he killed Billy Phillips. Walk across the street. He didn't walk across the street and kill Harry Parker. Call him Jim. Go ahead. Call him Jim to blood. And that…
When you were working for Billy Phillips, were you playing with the band or along?
